_comment: Every colour in the project. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE.
brand    → the :root token block in css/styles.css, rewritten by
accents  → the four microsite looks, read by tools/sync.js. Add a fifth
here and `accent: "<name>"` in a lawyer's microsite block
microsite.sections → which sections a microsite renders, and in what
order. A per-advocate `microsite.sections` array overrides it.
Run `npm run build` after editing. Contrast is checked by
`node tools/brand/check-contrast.js`, which exits non-zero if a body-text
pairing drops below WCAG AA — run it after changing `gold` or `muted`.

_brandNotes._comment: Descriptive only. The WCAG contrast ratio beside each text token in css/styles.css is MEASURED by tools/build-css.js at build time — never write a ratio here, it will go stale the moment the hex changes.

accents._comment: Each accent overrides the brand tokens on the microsite's :root. `btn` is [from, mid, to, text] for the primary call button, which hardcodes a gradient in css/styles.css and would otherwise stay brand-gold on a coloured site. null keeps the brand gradient.

microsite._comment: Default section order for every microsite. Drop a name to remove that section from all of them; a lawyer's own microsite.sections array overrides this list for that one advocate. `hero` and `footer` are structural and cannot be removed.
